item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00190","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C10","C07","C22"],"selected_candidate_label":"C10","confidence":0.82,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C10 plausibly supplied a concrete civic-observance template: historical or ideological recitals lead to designation of a specific day, a call for public ceremonies, and an exhortation that citizens reflect on the responsibilities represented by the observance. The child closely adapts that sequence to citizenship, urging Americans to reaffirm national principles and calling on officials and organizations to conduct exercises. C07 has a similar observance-and-mobilization structure, while C22 shares the youth, citizenship, and community-action themes, but neither matches the child's operative sequence as closely as C10.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"I urge all Americans on that day to reaffirm their faith in the principles and ideals to which this nation is dedicated and more firmly resolve to discharge in full the solemn obligations of their citizenship.","parent_excerpt":"I also urge all citizens to reflect upon the responsibilities which this banner enjoins as well as the privileges it carries","explanation":"Both attach an exhortation about citizens' responsibilities to a designated patriotic observance."},{"child_excerpt":"I call upon Federal, State, and local officials, as well as patriotic, civic, and educational organizations, to conduct exercises on or about May 15","parent_excerpt":"I call upon the people of the Nation to observe that day as Flag Day by suitable ceremonies","explanation":"Both use a call upon the public or organized groups to mark a specified national day through ceremonies or exercises."},{"child_excerpt":"the strength of our nation lies in the unity of all our people, of whatever race, creed, culture, or national origin","parent_excerpt":"Americans of varied heritage, creed, and race","explanation":"The recitals share a notably similar formulation presenting national unity across heritage, creed, and race."}]}
